skill_route.resolution: The mission-approved production registry entry and TC-FF6-MACH-001 bind complete ProductContract obligation slices to format-feature-expansion. The older generic route does not include digest-bound installed-package and independent-oracle requirements.

requested_operation: implement typed attachment add, replace, remove, and rename operations targeted by stable cell ID, with reference safety, validated MIME bundles, deterministic dry-run reports, and representation preservation

inputs.root_cause: The package preserved and validated notebook attachment mappings but exposed no bounded mutation contract. Callers therefore had to edit nested dictionaries directly, could target cells by unstable position, and could silently create dangling attachment references or alter source representation.
inputs.affected_layer: IPYNB typed model utilities, public lifecycle API, preservation behavior, and package documentation

defect_reproduction.outcome: Test collection failed because format_factory.ipynb exported no AttachmentReferencePolicy or attachment-management lifecycle.

implementation.targeting: Every operation resolves one markdown or raw cell by a required unique stable cell ID and rejects absent, duplicate, or unsupported code-cell targets.
implementation.add_replace: Add validates non-empty attachment names and non-empty JSON-compatible MIME bundles; replacement requires an explicit replace flag.
implementation.rename: Rename preserves attachment mapping order and rewrites literal and percent-encoded attachment URIs by default.
implementation.remove: Removal refuses referenced attachments by default and requires the explicit LEAVE_DANGLING policy to retain invalid references.
implementation.source_preservation: Reference rewriting preserves whether cell source was represented as a string or a string array.
implementation.reporting: Immutable reports capture operation, target path, deep-copied before/after values, reference counts, dangling-reference counts, and whether a mutation was applied.
implementation.dry_run: Every operation executes against an isolated deep copy and can return the exact report without mutating the document.
implementation.unknown_data: Notebook, cell, and attachment MIME-extension data outside the selected mutation are preserved.
implementation.tradeoff: Reference parsing is deliberately limited to nbformat attachment URI syntax in cell source. The library does not parse or rewrite arbitrary HTML, CSS, or vendor metadata references that merely resemble attachment links.
